title: Trump discloses more than 1,100 July trades, including up to $25 million each in sales of Microsoft, Amazon
summary_full: Trump sold tech stocks including Amazon and Microsoft when the Mag 7 stocks popped on July 20, adding $291 billion in market value in one day.
